publication_rule: release-operations publication must stop when a required upstream artifact, channel artifact, schema field, or same-major revert primitive is absent

diagnostic_classes.trigger: requested update crosses major ABI line
diagnostic_classes.required_action: block upgrade and require same-major revert channel

diagnostic_classes.trigger: candidate or preview channel requires retired runtime metadata behavior
diagnostic_classes.required_action: block publication and require a same-major revert channel

diagnostic_classes.trigger: offline bundle or installer receipt format changes across minor lines
diagnostic_classes.required_action: block publication until generated conversion replay and revert evidence exists

diagnostic_classes.trigger: requested channel is outside its support window
diagnostic_classes.required_action: publish deprecated-channel warning and recommend stable revert
